_provenance: Owner-confirmed list of six. I originally proposed ten; the owner cut four — fat-loss, anxiety-management, emotional-regulation, hormonal-health — on the grounds that applying it there would buy my caution at the price of most of the mindset domain, and that those belong under rule 13 (signals and caveats) like everything else. Do not re-add a category here without asking: this file raises the bar and narrowing the candidate pool is the owner's decision, not a research judgement. first-aid and camping-and-outdoor-skills added later, both owner-confirmed, with a rationale the owner was explicit should NOT be generalised — see the entry itself. On proposing further categories: the owner's ruling is to keep proposing rather than to self-censor. Over-proposing gets trimmed and leaves a record; under-proposing leaves no trace and nobody can correct it. Ask, do not pre-decide.
_comment: Categories where acting on bad advice can cause physical harm, delay treatment someone needs, or worsen a crisis. The bar is higher here and an empty category is explicitly preferred to an adjacent one: a bad recommendation costs more than an absent one. Owner's ruling, made about addiction-recovery and generalised. Adding a category here raises the standard; it never lowers one.

addiction-recovery.rationale: Dependence, withdrawal and relapse. Wrong or moralising advice can keep someone from treatment, and some withdrawal is medically dangerous.
addiction-recovery.visitorNote: Wrong or moralising information here can keep someone away from treatment, and some withdrawal is medically dangerous rather than merely unpleasant. Everything listed is education about the subject, not an assessment of anyone's situation.

injury-rehab.rationale: Loading an injury wrongly causes further injury. Physical and immediate. Anything here is education, never assessment.
injury-rehab.visitorNote: Loading an injury wrongly makes it worse, and nothing on a screen can see your injury. Treat these as education to use alongside a clinician who has examined you, not as a substitute for one.

back-pain-management.rationale: The category most likely to attract confident structural claims that frighten people out of moving, which is itself the harm.
back-pain-management.visitorNote: This subject attracts confident structural explanations that frighten people out of moving, which is itself one of the ways back pain gets worse. Listings here are education, not a diagnosis of your back.

grief-and-loss.rationale: People arrive acutely bereaved. Prescriptive stage models and timelines do documented harm.
grief-and-loss.visitorNote: People arrive at this subject acutely bereaved, and prescriptive stages and timelines are known to do harm. We held a higher bar than usual for what appears here, and it is still education rather than support.

supplements-literacy.rationale: DEFINITIONAL rather than precautionary, and the owner's framing is the right one: this category exists to teach someone how to JUDGE supplement claims. A creator who sells supplements is working against the category's own purpose, not merely carrying a conflict to be disclosed. This is the one place where commercial interest is disqualifying rather than a rule-13 signal, and it is disqualifying because of what the category is for.
supplements-literacy.visitorNote: This skill is about judging supplement claims, so creators who sell supplements are left out rather than flagged. That is a stricter rule than we apply anywhere else on this site, and it is because of what the skill is for.

therapy-literacy.rationale: The failure mode is steering someone away from help or toward the wrong modality. Narrowing here is only moderate, so the standard is cheap to hold.
therapy-literacy.visitorNote: The costly mistake here is being steered away from help, or toward the wrong kind of it. These listings explain what therapy is and how it works; none of them is therapy, and none can tell you what you need.

first-aid.rationale: ACUTE-RECALL, and the owner was specific that this reasoning is narrower than the other six. It is not that bad advice here is costly over time. It is that the content gets recalled under acute stress by someone who has no capacity to evaluate it in the moment — no time to check a second source, no attention left to notice that the presenter is confident rather than qualified. Everywhere else the visitor retains some ability to judge what they were told; here that ability is exactly what the situation removes. Do not extend this rationale to a category merely because its subject sounds serious: the test is whether the content is acted on under stress, from memory, with evaluation impossible.
first-aid.visitorNote: This is knowledge you would use under pressure, from memory, with no time to check a second source and no attention to spare for judging whether a presenter is qualified. Video can prepare you for a course. It cannot replace one, because certification exists to assess your hands.

camping-and-outdoor-skills.rationale: VERIFICATION UNAVAILABLE — and the owner was precise that this, not acute stress, is the load-bearing part. The test is not that the situation is frightening. It is that checking is structurally impossible: no signal, no second source, nobody to ask, and the consequence of a wrong call arrives before reconsideration is possible. That is what separates this from car-maintenance and home-repair-diy, which were considered and REJECTED: those are bench-side, pausable and checkable, so the viewer keeps the ability to verify. Physical harm alone was always too loose a test — if it qualified, rule 12 would cover half the taxonomy. Navigation and judgement about conditions are the content that carries this risk; gear reviews and trail guides do not.
camping-and-outdoor-skills.visitorNote: Outdoors you often cannot check what you were told — no signal, no second source, nobody to ask — and a wrong call lands before you can reconsider it. What is listed here covers planning and equipment. Navigation and wilderness first aid are worth learning somewhere that assesses you.

standard: Prefer a documented empty category to an adjacent or under-credentialed creator.
A creator here should normally carry the `credentialed` signal, or the record must say plainly why they are trustworthy without it.
`notFor` and `caveats` must state the limit explicitly — that this is education and not assessment or treatment.
A creator whose framing discourages professional help needs that named in their record, not softened.
In supplements-literacy only, selling the product class is disqualifying rather than disclosable — see the note on that category.
In first-aid only, the acute-recall rationale applies. It is not a general licence to raise the bar wherever harm is imaginable — see that category's entry.
In camping-and-outdoor-skills only, the verification-unavailable rationale applies. Ask whether the viewer can check the advice at the moment of use — not whether the subject is dangerous.
_schema: Each category: rationale (RESEARCH-FACING — why the bar is raised, including owner rulings; never shipped to the site) and visitorNote (VISITOR-FACING — a short factual statement about the subject, rendered above the creator list). The split is deliberate: the rationale references our own process and would read as self-regard on a page about learning a skill. build-data.mjs ships only the visitorNote, so the research prose cannot leak into the site by accident.
